faculty.name: Christopher R. Agnew
faculty.summary: Studies close interpersonal relationships and their impact on social and health processes, using relational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密的人际关系及其对社会和健康过程的影响，使用关系模型。

faculty.name: Ximena Arriaga
faculty.summary: Studies close connections and personal relationships, focusing on social psychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密关系和个人关系，侧重于社会心理学。

faculty.name: Stephen Broomell
faculty.summary: Studies how environmental factors influence judgment and decision-making, using lab experiments and statistical models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究环境因素如何影响判断和决策，使用实验室实验和统计模型。

faculty.name: Jennifer Brown
faculty.summary: Studies culturally-tailored interventions to prevent HIV/AIDS and improve substance use and reproductive health outcomes, using implementation science and cultural consensus modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究文化适应干预措施以预防艾滋病、改善物质使用和生殖健康结果，采用实施科学和文化共识建模方法。

faculty.name: Julia Chester
faculty.summary: Studies the development and characterization of animal models to understand the biological and behavioral mechanisms influencing alcohol use disorders and co-occurring conditions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物模型的发展和表征，以了解影响酒精使用障碍及其共病条件的生物和行为机制。

faculty.name: Yu-Chin Chiu
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive control, attention, and inhibitory response using fMRI and EEG to understand neurocognitive mechanisms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知控制、注意力和抑制反应，使用功能性磁共振成像和脑电图来理解神经认知机制。

faculty.name: Christopher Eckhardt
faculty.summary: Studies psychological risk factors for intimate partner violence, including cognitive distortions, alcohol use, and behavior change in treatment.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密伴侣暴力的心理风险因素，包括认知扭曲、酒精使用和治疗中的行为改变。

faculty.name: Dan Foti
faculty.summary: Studies the pathophysiology of psychiatric illnesses, particularly depression and schizophrenia, using EEG as an intermediate phenotype.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究精神疾病（尤其是抑郁症和精神分裂症）的病理生理机制，使用EEG作为中间表型。

faculty.name: Edward Fox
faculty.summary: Studies how neural pathways in the vagus nerve control food intake and metabolism, using mouse genetics and behavioral methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究迷走神经的神经通路如何控制食物摄入和新陈代谢，使用小鼠遗传学和行为学方法。

faculty.name: Monica Gamez-Djokic
faculty.summary: Studies how artificial intelligence and emerging technologies influence social perception, intergroup relations, and moral judgments, exploring biases and ethical evaluations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人工智能和其他新兴技术如何影响社会知觉、群体关系和道德判断，探讨偏见和伦理评价。

faculty.name: Alexandra Harris-Watson
faculty.summary: Studies how individual differences affect job performance and interpersonal dynamics in teams and AI collaborations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体差异如何影响工作表现和团队及人工智能合作中的人际动态。

faculty.name: Sébastien Hélie
faculty.summary: Studies automaticity, problem solving, and decision-making using computational cognitive neuroscience and neuroeconomics approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用计算认知神经科学和神经经济学方法研究自动化、问题解决和决策制定。

faculty.name: George Hollich
faculty.summary: Studies how infants perceive speech and learn words, using methods from epigenetic robotics and dynamic systems theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何感知语音和学习词汇，使用来自表观遗传机器人学和动力系统理论的方法。

faculty.name: Jeffrey D. Karpicke
faculty.summary: Studies how people remember information, using experiments to understand memory strategies and retrieval practices.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何记忆信息，通过实验了解记忆策略和检索实践。

faculty.name: Brandon Keehn
faculty.summary: Studies attentional strengths and weaknesses in autistic children using fMRI, EEG, and eye-tracking to identify early markers for diagnosis and intervention.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和眼动追踪技术研究自闭症儿童的注意力优势和劣势，以识别早期诊断和干预的生物标志物。

faculty.name: Andy Kim
faculty.summary: Studies how the locus coeruleus-noradrenaline system affects attention and emotional processing in aging, using eye tracking, EEG, neuroimaging, and cognitive assessments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究去甲肾上腺素系统如何影响老化过程中的注意力和情绪处理，使用眼动追踪、脑电图、神经影像学和认知评估方法。

faculty.name: Kimberly Kinzig
faculty.summary: Studies neuroendocrine regulation of food intake and body weight, and the neurobiology of eating disorders and stress.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经内分泌对食物摄入和体重的调节以及进食障碍和压力的神经生物学机制。

faculty.name: Teri Kirby
faculty.summary: Studies diversity, inclusion, and the effectiveness of diversity initiatives in organizations and society, focusing on identity, stereotypes, and unintended consequences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多样性和包容性及其在组织和社会中的有效性，重点关注身份、刻板印象和意外后果。

faculty.name: Liaison Representatives
faculty.summary: Works on integrating neuroscience with other Purdue University departments to achieve strategic goals.
faculty.summary_zh: 致力于将神经科学与其他普渡大学部门整合，以实现战略目标。

faculty.name: MD-PhD Training
faculty.summary: Recruits MD-PhD students for biomedical engineering research, fostering collaborations between Purdue and Indiana University.
faculty.summary_zh: 招募MD-PhD学生进行生物医学工程研究，促进普渡大学与印第安纳大学之间的合作。

faculty.name: Joshua Alexander
faculty.summary: Studies how hearing aids affect speech perception and individual differences in hearing aid benefit using hearing aid simulators and laboratory measures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究助听器对语音感知的影响以及个体在助听器益处方面的差异，使用助听器模拟器和实验室测量方法。

faculty.name: Satyajit Ambike
faculty.summary: Studies human movement stability and efficiency, particularly in older adults and those with Parkinson’s disease, using biomechanical and motor control methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类运动的稳定性和效率，特别是在老年人和帕金森病患者中的表现，使用生物力学和运动控制方法。

faculty.name: U Aryal
faculty.summary: Studies aging and age-related diseases using mass spectrometry to investigate proteomic and post-translational modifications.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用质谱研究衰老和年龄相关疾病中的蛋白质组和翻译后修饰。

faculty.name: Ed Bartlett
faculty.summary: Studies how hearing circuits function in normal and pathological conditions, examining sound representation from behavioral to molecular levels.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉电路在正常和病理条件下的功能，从行为到分子水平研究声音的表征。

faculty.name: Ximena Bernal
faculty.summary: Studies how natural enemies influence animal communication systems and human impacts on these networks, focusing on frogs and their predators.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自然天敌如何影响动物的交流系统及其人类活动对这些网络的影响，重点关注蛙类及其捕食者。

faculty.name: Alexander Chubykin
faculty.summary: Studies how neuromodulatory systems affect visual perception circuits using optogenetics, electrophysiology, and mouse models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经调质系统如何影响视觉感知回路，使用光遗传学、电生理学和小鼠模型。

faculty.name: Laura Claxton
faculty.summary: Studies how infants learn to balance and the impact of object interactions on their gait and posture, using observational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何学习平衡以及物体交互对其步态和姿势的影响，使用观察方法。

faculty.name: Ulrike Dydak
faculty.summary: Studies manganese toxicity in humans using MRI and MRS techniques to measure neurochemical changes and brain dynamics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类锰中毒的认知神经科学方法，使用MRI和MRS技术测量神经化学变化和大脑动态。

faculty.name: Esteban Fernandez-Juricic
faculty.summary: Studies the co-evolution of avian visual system properties with behaviors and human-wildlife interactions in protected areas.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鸟类视觉系统属性与行为之间的共进化以及在保护区的人类-野生动物互动。

faculty.name: Alexander Francis
faculty.summary: Studies how listening effort affects cognitive engagement and health in older adults, using psychophysiological measures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听力努力如何影响老年人的认知参与和健康，使用生理心理测量方法。

faculty.name: Jennifer Freeman
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of toxicity from environmental stressors in developmental neurotoxicity and neurodegenerative diseases using zebrafish models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究环境应激因素在发育神经毒性和神经退行性疾病中的遗传和表观遗传机制，使用斑马鱼模型进行研究。

faculty.name: Elliot Friedman
faculty.summary: Studies biological processes related to health and well-being in aging adults, focusing on inflammation and sleep.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与健康和福祉相关的生物学过程在老年人中的作用，重点关注炎症和睡眠。

faculty.name: Stephanie Gardner
faculty.summary: Studies how undergraduate students learn and apply scientific reasoning and graphing skills in biology through active experimentation and visualization methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究本科生在生物学中通过主动实验和可视化方法学习和应用科学推理和绘图技能。

faculty.name: Allen Garner
faculty.summary: Develops biomedical applications of pulsed power and plasmas, including platelet activation and growth factor release.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发脉冲功率和等离子体的生物医学应用，包括血小板激活和生长因子释放。

faculty.name: Joaquin Goni
faculty.summary: Studies complex systems, graph theory, and neuroimaging to understand brain connectomics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究复杂系统、图论和神经成像以理解大脑连接组学。

faculty.name: Jeffrey Haddad
faculty.summary: Studies changes in postural stability and manual control across the lifespan, using non-linear dynamics and analytical techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究不同年龄段的姿势稳定性和手动控制的变化，使用非线性动力学和分析技术。

faculty.name: Michael Heinz
faculty.summary: Studies the neural correlates of normal and impaired auditory perception, using neurophysiology, computational modeling, and psychoacoustics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究正常和受损听觉感知的神经相关性，使用神经生理学、计算建模和听觉生理学方法。

faculty.name: Fang Huang
faculty.summary: Studies neural networks and machine learning, focusing on computational neuroscience and brain-inspired algorithms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经网络和机器学习，专注于计算神经科学和脑启发算法。

faculty.name: Muhammad Hussain
faculty.summary: Develops futuristic electronics, focusing on micro and nano-scale device fabrication.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发未来电子技术，专注于微纳米尺度器件的制造。

faculty.name: Afshin Izadian
faculty.summary: Studies optical neuromodulation using nanoparticles and quantum dots to develop injectable artificial photoreceptors for vision restoration.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究光神经调控技术，使用纳米颗粒和量子点开发可注射的人工视网膜，用于恢复视力。

faculty.name: Natalya Kaganovich
faculty.summary: Studies how children combine auditory and visual information, focusing on multisensory processing in speech perception and its role in developmental language disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何结合听觉和视觉信息，特别是在语音感知中的多感官处理及其在发育性语言障碍中的作用。

faculty.name: David Kemmerer
faculty.summary: Studies how people’s knowledge of word meanings is implemented in the brain, focusing on semantics, grammar, perception, and action.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究单词意义知识在大脑中的实现方式，重点在于语义学、语法、知觉和动作之间的关系。

faculty.name: Patrick Kerstein
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic and molecular factors that define neuronal cell types and connectivity in the visual system, and how gene-environment interactions disrupt normal nervous system development during.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉系统中神经元细胞类型和连接性的遗传和分子因素，以及基因-环境相互作用如何在眼内毒物暴露期间扰乱正常神经系统发育。

faculty.name: Kwang Seob Kim
faculty.summary: Studies stuttering and sensorimotor learning in speech motor control using computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究口吃和运动学习在言语运动控制中的作用，使用计算模型方法。

faculty.name: Tamara Kinzer-Ursem
faculty.summary: Develops technologies for medical applications, contributing to global health through biomedical engineering.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发医疗技术，通过生物医学工程为全球健康做出贡献。

faculty.name: Greg Knipp
faculty.summary: Develops models for assessing pharmaceutical performance, focusing on neurotoxicity screening and antiviral compound development.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发药物性能评估模型，专注于神经毒性筛查和抗病毒化合物开发。

faculty.name: Nan Kong
faculty.summary: Develops computational models for disease management and healthcare scheduling.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发疾病管理和医疗调度的计算模型。

faculty.name: Arianna Lacroix
faculty.summary: Studies how language and cognition interact in individuals with brain injuries, using fMRI and eye-tracking to improve communication abilities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言和认知在脑损伤个体中的相互作用，使用功能性磁共振成像和眼动追踪技术以提高沟通能力。

faculty.name: Hongmi Lee
faculty.summary: Studies how the human brain stores and recalls memories for naturalistic experiences, using behavioral experiments and functional magnetic resonance imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何存储和回忆自然经历的记忆，使用行为实验和功能性磁共振成像。

faculty.name: Hugh Lee
faculty.summary: Develops technologies to improve healthcare, collaborating with biomedical engineers.
faculty.summary_zh: 与生物医学工程师合作开发改善医疗的技术。

faculty.name: Ji Yeon Lee
faculty.summary: Studies aphasia rehabilitation and age-related communication disorders using implicit structural priming and sentence production tasks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究失语症康复和与年龄相关的交流障碍，使用隐性结构 priming 和 句子生成 任务。

faculty.name: Laurence Leonard
faculty.summary: Studies the nature of childhood language disorders, focusing on grammatical symptoms and word learning interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童语言障碍的本质，重点关注语法症状和词汇学习干预。

faculty.name: Maria Makin
faculty.summary: Studies how animals learn to use new sensory information for movement, applying this to neural prostheses for recovery from injury.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物如何利用新感觉信息进行运动学习，并将其应用于神经假体以促进损伤恢复。

faculty.name: Kristine Marceau
faculty.summary: Studies gene-environment interplay and its effects on behavior and substance use across development, using longitudinal and twin designs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基因-环境交互作用及其对行为和物质使用在发展过程中的影响，使用纵向和双生子设计。

faculty.name: Ernesto Marinero
faculty.summary: Studies fundamental and applied science in neuroengineering.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事神经工程的基础和应用科学研究。

faculty.name: Rebecca Marks
faculty.summary: Studies how language development supports reading acquisition in children, using fMRI and fNIRS to examine word processing and reading development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言发展如何支持儿童的阅读习得，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和功能性近红外光谱(fNIRS)来考察单词处理和阅读发展。

faculty.name: Richard Mattes
faculty.summary: Studies how taste, appetite, and food intake influence energy balance and cephalic phase responses in humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究味觉、食欲和食物摄入如何影响能量平衡以及人类的头期胰岛素反应。

faculty.name: Rebecca McNally Keehn
faculty.summary: Develops and evaluates service models to improve equitable access to autism diagnosis and care in minoritized and resource-constrained communities.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和评估服务模型，以提高对少数族裔和资源匮乏社区自闭症诊断和护理的公平可及性。

faculty.name: Saeed Mohammadi
faculty.summary: Designs high-speed and low-power electronics and novel semiconductor devices for 3-D integration.
faculty.summary_zh: 设计高速低功耗电子器件和新型半导体器件以实现三维集成。

faculty.name: Jane Mondul
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of noise on hearing, focusing on olivocochlear efferent systems and hearing-in-noise abilities in both humans and animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究噪声对听觉的影响，重点关注橄榄-耳蜗外周系统和噪声环境下的听觉能力，涉及人类和动物模型。

faculty.name: Linda Nie
faculty.summary: Develops x-ray and neutron technologies to quantify metals and trace elements in the human body and animals, aiming to bridge technology development and human health applications.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发X射线和中子技术以定量人体和动物体内的金属和痕量元素，旨在将技术开发与人类健康应用相结合。

faculty.name: Niwako Ogata
faculty.summary: Studies mental health and well-being in companion animals, translating findings to human psychiatric research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究伴侣动物的心理健康和福祉，并将其发现应用于人类精神医学研究。

faculty.name: Brandon Pitts
faculty.summary: Studies how aging affects attention and information processing in multimodal displays, using engineering methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究老化对多模态显示中注意力和信息处理的影响，使用工程方法。

faculty.name: Vitaliy Rayz
faculty.summary: Develops technologies for biomedical engineering, helping 10 million patients worldwide.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发生物医学工程技术，帮助全球1000万患者。

faculty.name: Thomas Redick
faculty.summary: Studies working memory, investigating individual differences, cognitive interventions, and augmented reality technology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作记忆，探索个体差异、认知干预和增强现实技术。

faculty.name: Jenna Rickus
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何从社会线索中学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Shirley Rietdyk
faculty.summary: Studies the interaction between neural and mechanical systems in mobility, posture, and balance, focusing on how the nervous system integrates sensory information to prevent trips and falls.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经和机械系统在移动、姿势和平衡中的相互作用，重点在于神经系统如何整合感官信息以防止绊倒和跌倒。

faculty.name: Allison Schaser
faculty.summary: Studies protein aggregation in mouse models of Parkinson disease and Dementia with Lewy Bodies using advanced imaging tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用先进的成像工具研究帕金森病和路易体痴呆的小鼠模型中的蛋白质聚集。

faculty.name: A.J. Schwichtenberg
faculty.summary: Studies how sleep and biosocial processes are developmentally consequential for children and families, focusing on neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠和生物社会过程对儿童和家庭发展的意义，重点关注神经发育和神经退行性疾病。

faculty.name: Anne Sereno
faculty.summary: Studies the physiological mechanisms of attention, short-term memory, and eye movements to diagnose and treat related disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意、短期记忆和眼球运动的生理机制，以诊断和治疗相关障碍。

faculty.name: Maureen Shader
faculty.summary: Studies auditory perception and cortical processing in adults with cochlear implants using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS).
faculty.summary_zh: 研究植入人工耳蜗成人的听觉感知和皮层处理，使用功能性近红外光谱成像（fNIRS）技术。

faculty.name: Riyi Shi
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using computational models and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Jeffrey Siskind
faculty.summary: Studies artificial intelligence and computational linguistics, focusing on machine vision and child language acquisition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人工智能和计算语言学，专注于机器视觉和儿童语言习得。

faculty.name: Susie Swithers
faculty.summary: Studies how lifestyle factors affect health and longevity, focusing on behavior and development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生活方式因素如何影响健康和长寿，重点关注行为和发展。

faculty.name: Shiliang Tian
faculty.summary: Studies the functions and mechanisms of metalloproteins using spectroscopic and computational techniques, aiming to understand metal ion homeostasis in neurodegenerative diseases and design.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究金属蛋白的功能和机制，使用光谱和计算技术，旨在理解金属离子在神经退行性疾病中的稳态以及设计功能性金属蛋白。

faculty.name: Yunjie Tong
faculty.summary: Develops technologies to improve healthcare, collaborating with biomedical engineers.
faculty.summary_zh: 与生物医学工程师合作开发改善医疗的技术。

faculty.name: Juan Wachs
faculty.summary: Develops assistive technologies and health support systems using machine and computer vision, robotics, and human-computer interaction.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发辅助技术和健康支持系统，使用机器和计算机视觉、机器人技术和人机交互。

faculty.name: Kevin Webb
faculty.summary: Studies mathematical and physical problems in optics, solid-state devices, and communication, with experimental and theoretical aspects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究光学、固态器件和通信中的数学和物理问题，具有实验和理论方面的研究。

faculty.name: Robbee Wedow
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Ellen Wells
faculty.summary: Studies the development of health and wellness, focusing on environmental and occupational health.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究发展健康和福祉，重点关注环境和职业健康。

faculty.name: Ronnie Wilbur
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Wenzhuo Wu
faculty.summary: Develops self-powered nanosystems and smart sensors for renewable energy and human-integrated technologies.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发自供能纳米系统和智能传感器，用于可再生能源和人体集成技术。

faculty.name: Howard Zelaznik
faculty.summary: Studies how movement timing and learning affect healthy lifestyles and longevity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动时序和学习如何影响健康生活方式和长寿。

faculty.name: Purdue Hotline
faculty.summary: Develops and manages a confidential hotline for reporting academic misconduct and other issues at Purdue University.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和管理一个保密热线，用于报告学术不端和其他问题的普渡大学。
